preregistered.screen: 4 jobs of 9 iterations at 600 samples; each input runs 6 candidate seeds: its job-02 seed, its job-03 seed and four new seeds
preregistered.event: an accepted event carries exactly three threshold clicks across all 24 returned modes, two on the analyzer in a frame-table pattern, one on b and none on the heralds or outside the logical modes; it is correct when the frame-decoded receiver bit equals the input's expected bit
preregistered.selection: per input, the candidate with the highest screen correctness (correct / accepted); ties go to more accepted events, then to the lower candidate index; a candidate with no accepted event is not selected
preregistered.confirm: 2 jobs that each replay the six selected seeds at 1200 samples, the first in design order and the second mirrored
preregistered.baseline: per input, the mean over its candidates of their screen correctness, averaged over the six inputs; its variance is the sum over inputs of the between-candidate sample variance over the candidate count, divided by 36
preregistered.primary: confirm correctness (per input, correct over accepted pooled over the confirm jobs, averaged over the six inputs) minus the baseline, z = difference / sqrt(confirm binomial variance + baseline variance), one-sided at alpha 0.05; the selected candidates' screen scores enter no test
preregistered.secondary: the confirm pool's correctness and its anytime-valid lower bound at alpha 0.01 and lambda 0.142433; whether each replay returns its screen iteration's computed_circuit; whether the job-02 and job-03 seeds return their retained meshes
preregistered.excluded: no classical comparison: a mesh selected per input from that input's own screen data makes the instrument depend on the input label, which the rehearsal's classical comparisons exclude
preregistered.stopping: the case stops for the owner when the first screen job runs past 270 s, a job returns fewer iterations than requested, the platform's HOM, g2 or transmittance read changes between screen and confirm, or a confirm replay returns a mesh other than its screen iteration's
